Hedlund Appliance Service is a local appliance repair company serving Jacksonville Beach, Atlantic Beach, Neptune Beach, Ponte Vedra Beach, Intracoastal West, Southside, and nearby Jacksonville, Florida neighborhoods within about 15 miles of Jacksonville Beach and San Pablo Road South.

## Pricing Signal

The in-town service call is currently $135. Diagnosis is included, and same-visit labor is included when the repair can be completed without parts.
